//: Copy this file to appsettings.Local.json next to each *.Api project (and ApiGateway) before the first run, or set the same values as environment variables such as Jwt__SigningKey. appsettings.Local.json is git-ignored, so no key, password or connection secret is ever committed.

Jwt.//: Any string of 32 characters or more. Every service must use the same one, or a token issued by Identity will not validate elsewhere.

ProfileActiveGate.//: ApiGateway only: how long (seconds) it remembers identity.Profiles.Status after one database read. Deactivated sessions may keep working until this window expires.

Seed.//: The first administrator, created on startup when the table is empty. Used by the Identity service only.
